kind cases and closedField on mijnZaken. Portaliq change cases-my-cases-page (merged, T08 hands this half to dossiq) lists no dossiq case until mijnZaken declares kind cases and closedField endDate; dossiq#3152 records it live (PortalCaseListReader keeps only kind cases). Reading the code also showed the case collection is served to no audience a portal login carries (dossiq answers citizen, DigiD sessions carry client, eHerkenning supplier), so the change serves it to those too. No dossiq change covers it. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on.

branchField on the case collection. Portaliq change signin-eherkenning-branch (merged, T07 hands this half to dossiq) needs a case app to store the branch a business filed under and declare branchField; until then a branch-restricted session sees none of its cases. The case schema has no branch field. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on.

referenceField on the case collection. Portaliq change identity-ways-in-screens (merged) needs the case app to declare which field holds the case number for a reference session. The change declares referenceField identifier and portalIdentityKind on the case type, and admits reference on no case type while portaliq issues a reference link without checking the address against the case. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on.

citizenWrite update action. Portaliq changes what-the-citizen-may-write-on-their-own-case, case-actions-withdraw-screen and withdrawing-your-own-case-from-the-portal (merged) depend on a dossiq update action on case carrying citizenWrite and on the case type declaring portalWritable, the two windows and portalWithdrawal; without it CitizenCaseController answers 403 portal-writes-not-declared for every dossiq case (dossiq#3152). No dossiq change covers it. Build: a half merged sibling changes depend on.

ask-partner row action. Portaliq change partner-tasks-in-the-portal asks dossiq to declare ask-partner and retire ExternalConsultationResponse (dossiq row 3.19). Open dossiq change case-sharing-mints-access-links covers row 3.19 by capability on another road: an external party answers a case through an OpenRegister access link with the comment capability, and it already deleted the ExternalConsultationResponse token page (its tasks 5.1 to 5.4). Whether dossiq should also declare portaliq's partner-audience ask-partner as a second road is a product question, not a gap.

propose-change row action. Portaliq change change-proposal-queue (merged) hands dossiq the propose-change action with its proposable list and the queue on the case page (dossiq row 2.21). The dossiq umbrella competitor-parity-2026-09 lists this half without a change, and case-sharing-mints-access-links leaves the portal queue for 2.21 out. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on.

contact-details listener. Portaliq change identity-profile-page (merged) raises PortalContactDetailsChangedEvent when a resident sets their contact channel and says a case app that sends letters listens for it; dossiq reads case.communicationChannel as the recorded choice (CaseTypeAcknowledgement::channelFor) and nothing sets it from the portal. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on. The listener stays inert until portaliq emits the event.

client-write listener. Portaliq change inbox-notifications-and-preferences asks dossiq for a listener on PortalClientWriteEvent that tells the handler about a resident's amendment, document or task answer. Built without an OpenSpec change by dossiq#3144 (commit 9d8fde86a): lib/Listener/PortalClientWriteListener.php hands each act to ApplicantPortalActs, which records it on the timeline with a follow-up and notifies the assignee. It hears nothing until portal-citizen-writes-on-the-case lets portaliq accept the writes.

planninq projects leaf on the case schema. Planninq change integration-case-bridge (merged) asks dossiq to add planninq-projects to the case schema's linked types so the Projects panel shows on the case page; its rows int-project-from-case and int-archive-to-case carry tender demand (TenderNed 365739). No dossiq change places it. Build: a half a merged sibling change depends on.

TenantBrandingSanitiser parallel path, the half the thematiq lane handed to dossiq: branding is thematiq's (row 11.14 provider thematiq, built.owner ConductionNL/thematiq; hydra ADR-010 openspec/architecture/adr-010-nl-design.md, theme switching through the nldesign token sets), so dossiq builds no branding of its own. The parallel path is unreached code, not a capability: TenantConfigurationService::getThemingTokens(), sanitiseBranding() and sanitiseCustomCss(), and the TenantBrandingSanitiser behind them, have no caller in lib/ or src/ at c8ac7427e. Removing it is inherited debt for the sweep.

Single competitor, no demand. Only opencase rates it yes (zaaksysteem partial, no client code), there is no tender, feature request or roadmap row, and document notes sit outside the core area (intake and case core). Reversible: set back to none if demand appears.
